newsitem.title: UK: Pearson drops Institutional Investor bid.
newsitem.headline: Pearson drops Institutional Investor bid.

text.p: British publisher Pearson Plc has withdrawn form the bidding contest for U.S. publishing group Institutional Investor, sources close to Pearson said on Monday. Last month, a Pearson spokeswoman said Pearson was possibly interesting in buying Institutional Investor which publishes the popular weekly trade journal of the same name.
Pearson officials were not immediately available for comment on Monday.
But a source close to Pearson said the company withdrew because it "could not make the acquisition fit" its criteria to provide adequate return to shareholders.
"Such investments have to stand on their own and add value for the shareholders," the source said.
Pearson, which owns the Financial Times, said recently it was interested in buying the Australian Financial Review daily published by John Fairfax Holdings Ltd.
